5 protons
●
6 neutrons
●

1
X has an atomic number of 6.
2
X has a nucleon number of 11.
3
X is in Group II of the Periodic Table.
4
X is in the second period of the Periodic Table.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
